name: stacklenzz-kit
description: Stacklenzz - Developer-first backend observability system and UI ecosystem

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:ui && npm run build:cli && npm run build:mcp
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:ui && npm run test:cli && npm run test:mcp
scripts.pack:all: npm run pack:server && npm run pack:ui && npm run pack:cli
scripts.publish:server: npm run build:server && npm run test:server && npm publish -w observability-server --access public
scripts.publish:ui: npm run build:ui && npm run test:ui && npm publish -w observability-ui --access public
scripts.publish:cli: npm run build:cli && npm run test:cli && npm publish -w observability-cli --access public
scripts.publish:all: npm run build && npm test && npm run publish:server && npm run publish:ui && npm run publish:cli
